name: Keeper Squire
description: Governance and audit reviewer. Walks audit logs, summarizes drift, and reports compliance status against POA&M items. Low sensitivity because it only reads from audit log and GRC corpus and produces summary text.

skills.name: Audit Walk
skills.description: Walks the audit log over a time window and surfaces events tied to a control family.

skills.name: Governance Review
skills.description: Reviews an artifact against the active policy set and reports gaps.

skills.name: POA&M Status
skills.description: Reports current status of POA&M items by id with cited evidence.
